diagnostics.message:
[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run1]
The `adot` add-on deployed by `module.eks-addons` requires cert-manager to be installed and ready, but cert-manager is created by `module.base`, not `module.ctl`. `module.eks-addons` only has `depends_on = [module.ctl]`; it has no direct dependency on `module.base`. The cert-manager ordering currently only holds indirectly because `module.ctl` happens to `depends_on module.base`, so the real requirement (adot → cert-manager from base) is not expressed directly. It should depend directly on `module.base` (a bare `depends_on` is appropriate here since adot consumes no output of the cert-manager module).

----------------------------------------

[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run3]
module.eks-addons installs the `adot` add-on, whose own comment states it "requires a cert-manager from helm-addons." cert-manager is provisioned by module.base (base = cert-manager + metrics-server), not by module.ctl. Yet eks-addons only declares `depends_on = [module.ctl]`, so it does not directly depend on module.base where cert-manager actually lives — the ordering is only accidentally satisfied via ctl→base. The cert-manager readiness that adot needs should be expressed directly as a dependency on module.base.
